title: Training Notes: The Default Clock After an Early Interest Payment on Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
**The rule.** Where the member paid the interest share of a Farm Real Estate Loans installment early, the default clock starts later: when the latest interest payment came within the late-charge grace period, counted from the due date as day 0, the clock starts at the end of the grace period, so the grace days are taken off the days counted; when the latest interest payment came after the grace period but before the day the installment was paid in full, the clock starts on the day of that interest payment, so the days from the due date to that payment are taken off; otherwise the clock starts on the due date.

The latest interest payment is the most recent interest payment in the loan's transaction history. "Within the grace period" means received no later than the last grace day.

## Grace period by product

| Product | Late-charge grace period (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 15 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 15 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 15 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 15 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 15 |

## Input — judgement — result

| Latest interest payment received on | Installment paid in full on | Clock starts | Days taken off the days counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 10 | day 100 | end of the grace period | 15 |
| day 15 (last grace day) | day 100 | end of the grace period | 15 |
| day 16 | day 100 | day 16 | 16 |
| day 40 | day 100 | day 40 | 40 |
| day 100 | day 100 | due date | 0 |
| none within the grace period and none between the grace period and day 100 | day 100 | due date | 0 |

The installments in this table are hypothetical, each on a product with a 15-day grace period and the due date as day 0.

## Questions answered

**Does an interest payment made on the very day the installment was paid in full move the clock?** No; it is neither within the grace period nor before the day paid in full, so the clock starts on the due date.

**Does a partial interest payment within the grace period count?** The rule turns on when the latest interest payment came, not on its size.
